episodes.topic: Kushanabh ki 100 kanyayein, Gadhi aur Vishwamitra ka vansh (Kaushiki nadi)
Ganga ka janm: Himavan ki do betiyan, Ganga aur Uma

facts: Mithila ke raaste mein Ram Ahalya ko mukt karte hain.
Ahalya ko uske pati rishi Gautam ne shraap diya tha.

episodes.topic: Pushp Vatika mein Ram aur Sita
facts: Ram aur Sita mahal ke bageeche (Pushp Vatika) mein milte hain.
Pehli nazar mein dono ke man mein prem jaagta hai.
Raja Janak ki beti Sita ka swayamvar hota hai.
Ram Shiv ka dhanush todte hain aur swayamvar mein Sita ko jeette hain.
Swayamvar ke hisse mein Parashuram bhi aate hain (unki baatcheet ki pakki jaankari nahi; kuch mat gadho).

episodes.topic: Chaaron bhaiyon ka vivah aur vidaai
facts: Vivah tay hota hai; Ram aur Sita ka vivah.
Lakshman ka vivah Urmila se, Bharat ka Mandavi se, Shatrughna ka Shrutakirti se.
Dulhanein bhaavuk hokar apne mata-pita se vida leti hain.

episodes.topic: Ayodhya mein Sita aur Ram ko uttaradhikari banane ki ghoshna
facts: Sita Ayodhya aati hain.
Raja Dasharatha Ram ko apna uttaradhikari ghoshit karte hain.

episodes.topic: Manthara aur Kaikeyi ke do var
facts: Manthara Kaikeyi ke man mein zeher bharti hai.
Kaikeyi do var maangti hai: Bharat ko raajgaddi aur Ram ko 14 saal ka vanvas.

episodes.topic: Ram, Sita aur Lakshman ka vanvas
facts: Ram, Sita aur Lakshman van ke liye Ayodhya chhodte hain.
Nishadraj Guha unhe nadi paar karne mein madad karta hai.
Teeno Chitrakoot mein rehne lagte hain.
Raaste mein Bharadwaj ka ashram aur Valmiki ka ashram aata hai.

episodes.topic: Dasharatha ka dehant aur Bharat ki wapsi
facts: Raja Dasharatha dukh mein praan tyaag dete hain.
Bharat aur Shatrughna lautte hain.
Bharat raajgaddi lene se mana karte hain.
Dasharatha ki mrityu ke hisse mein Shravan Kumar ki katha aati hai (uske vistaar ki jaankari SERIAL_REF mein nahi).

episodes.topic: Bharat Milap aur Ram ki charan paduka
facts: Bharat Ram ko dhoondhne jaate hain aur bhai milte hain.
Ram samay se pehle lautne se mana karte hain.
Bharat Ram ki paduka Ayodhya le jaate hain aur Nandigram se raaj sambhalte hain.
Ram, Sita aur Lakshman rishi Atri aur Anasuya se milte hain.
Ram rakshason ke naash ka sankalp lete hain.
Agastya rishi Ram ko baan dete hain.
Ram Jatayu se pehli baar milte hain.
Teeno Panchvati mein bas jaate hain.
Shurpanakha ka vivah prastav thukraya jaata hai aur Lakshman uski naak kaat dete hain.

episodes.topic: Khar-Dushan ka ant aur Ravan ki chaal
facts: Khar aur Dushan ki sena Ram ke haathon nasht hoti hai.
Ravan Sita ko le jaane ki yojana banata hai.

episodes.topic: Sone ka hiran aur Sita haran
facts: Ravan Maricha ko hiran banakar bhejta hai taaki Ram aur Lakshman door jaayein.
Ravan Sita ko har le jaata hai.
Jatayu Sita ko bachane ki koshish mein ghaayal hota hai.
Ghaayal Jatayu Ram ko sab batata hai aur praan tyaag deta hai; Ram uska antim sanskaar karte hain.
Ram aur Lakshman Kabandh se milte hain aur Shabari ke ashram pahunchte hain.
Hanuman Ram se milte hain.
Ram aur Sugriv ki mitrata hoti hai.
Sugriv Ram ko Bali ke baare mein batate hain.
Ram Bali ko maarte hain.
Sugriv raja bante hain.

episodes.topic: Lakshman ka krodh aur Sita ki khoj
facts: Sugriv aur Angad Ram ka aashirvaad lene aate hain.
Lakshman gusse mein Kishkindha mein aate hain.
Sita ki khoj shuru hoti hai.
Jambavan Hanuman ko unki soi hui shakti yaad dilate hain.
Hanuman udkar Lanka pahunchte hain.
Hanuman Ashok Vatika mein Sita se milte hain.
Hanuman Ashok Vatika ujaadte hain aur Akshay Kumar ko maarte hain.
Hanuman Ravan se milte hain aur Lanka jalate hain.
Hanuman Sita se vida lete hain.
Hanuman lautkar Ram ko Sita ka samachar dete hain.
Vibhishan ko Lanka se nikaal diya jaata hai.
Vibhishan Ram se milte hain.
Samudra par setu banta hai aur poora hota hai.
Ram ka baan Ravan ka mukut gira deta hai.
Sugriv aur Ravan ka dwandva hota hai.
Ram Angad ko shaanti doot banakar Ravan ke darbar bhejte hain; Angad chunauti dete hain.
Mandodari Ravan se badon ki salaah maanne ko kehti hai.
Yuddh shuru hota hai aur Ravan ranbhoomi mein aata hai.
Kumbhakaran ko jagaya jaata hai aur uska vadh hota hai.
Atikaya sahit kai rakshas yodha maare jaate hain; Atikaya ko Lakshman maarte hain.
Indrajit Ram aur Lakshman ko Nagpash mein baandhta hai.
Garud unhe mukt karte hain.
Lakshman Indrajit ke shakti astra se ghaayal hote hain.
Hanuman Sushen Vaidya ko laate hain.
Hanuman Himalaya se Sanjeevani wala parvat laate hain aur Lakshman theek hote hain.
Indrajit tantrik yagya karne jaata hai.
Indrajit ka vadh hota hai.
Ravan ranbhoomi mein Ram se ladta hai.
Indra Ram ke liye apna rath bhejte hain.
Ravan ka vadh hota hai aur yuddh khatam hota hai.
Sita ki agni pariksha hoti hai.
Ram Ayodhya ki or chalte hain.
Ram ka rajyabhishek hota hai.
